title: From Recognition to Connection: What Kenya Taught Us About Team and Culture
summary: This year’s Outstanding Employees trip took 18 colleagues to Kenya for connection, reflection, and a reminder of what makes this place special.
body_markdown:
Excellence can take many shapes.
A quiet initiative that solved a bottleneck.
A moment of leadership no one expected.
A year of showing up with heart.


Once a year, a few of these moments are recognized in a way that’s just as meaningful: with a shared journey to somewhere far from the office, and closer to inspiration.
This year’s Outstanding Employees trip took a group of 18 colleagues to Kenya for connection, reflection, and a reminder of what makes this place special.


Here are their stories:
